info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Expires-v3-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Expiration Lookup API allows users to retrieve information about loyalty program expiration dates for enrolled members. This endpoint enables businesses to manage customer engagement by providing insights on when loyalty points or rewards are set to expire. Typically utilized by customer service representatives and marketing teams, this API helps in proactive communication with customers about their loyalty rewards status. By leveraging this data, companies can enhance customer loyalty strategies and optimize reward redemption efforts.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of loyalty points that have expired, enabling better account management and user experience. It helps in keeping track of user loyalty rewards and their status.

requestBody.description: Request body for expiring loyalty points. This operation allows the client to specify which loyalty points to expire based on certain criteria.

200.description: Successful retrieval of loyalty expiration details.
